Based on the Cartwheel policies, here’s how things work when a refund is pending and a dispute is opened:

1. **Pending Refund**: When a customer opens a dispute, it pauses any pending refund associated with that order. This means the refund will not be processed until the dispute is resolved.

2. **Dispute Handling**: Disputes are handled manually by a human support agent, which can take some time. They will review the case and make a determination.

3. **Refund Impact**: If the dispute is upheld, the refund may subsequently proceed based on the resolution. On the other hand, if the dispute is not upheld, the refund process can resume.

You can find more details in the respective policies: the [Cartwheel Refund Policy (cw-refunds)](https://help.cartwheel.com/cw-refunds) and the [Cartwheel Dispute Policy (cw-disputes)](https://help.cartwheel.com/cw-disputes).

If you have further specific questions or need to take action regarding this situation, just let me know!

Based on the Cartwheel policies, here’s how things work when a refund is pending and a dispute is opened:

1. **Pending Refund**: When a customer opens a dispute, it pauses any pending refund associated with that order. This means the refund will not be processed until the dispute is resolved.

3. **Refund Impact**: If the dispute is upheld, the refund may subsequently proceed based on the resolution. On the other hand, if the dispute is not upheld, the refund process can resume.

You can find more details in the respective policies: the [Cartwheel Refund Policy (cw-refunds)](https://help.cartwheel.com/cw-refunds) and the [Cartwheel Dispute Policy (cw-disputes)](https://help.cartwheel.com/cw-disputes).
